item.title: Releases
item.description: Changelog All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file. Builder contract, release 1. The builder contract (ADR-038, “thin core plus admissible sugar”) removes several hundred Create*/Set*/Add* helpers and every value the constructors used to inject. Every removal is listed once, with the expression that replaces it, in Builder contract: release 1 migration notes : the deleted helpers and sub-type constructors, and the constructor and workflow defaults that no longer apply. Read it before upgrading across the entries below. The contract itself is Kubernetes Builders .
